note: Passages only. Décret n°2026-0446/PT-RM of 21 July 2026 names the members of the board of the Agence nationale de Sécurisation des Actes d'Etat civil (ANSAEC), among them the Directeur de l'état civil, a representative of the minister for the digital economy and a staff representative, citing the agency's creating ordinance and Décret n°2025-0122/PT-RM of 24 February 2025 on its organisation. It names an agency, not an information system, and states nothing on events, how a record is made or offices.
